purpose: Lead independently audits stored geometry and sign comparison, without duplicate BVP solves.
method: Cubic Hermite reconstruction using all saved states and frozen RHS derivatives; separate quadrature in rho for area-weighted mean and projected area.

checks.sign: Report ordered finite differences at common accepted amplitudes, not global monotonicity.
checks.normalization: H/Csource and depth/(c_repo*ell); material alpha_coat=x^2/2, projected alpha=r_edge^2/2.

limitations: Quadrature independence is an implementation check on the same numerical solution, not independent physical evidence. Mean tolerance allows the existing fixed-grid trapezoid edge-integration error.
